# Infrastructure Integration Standards

This directory contains standards for infrastructure-level integration components, event brokers, and platform integration patterns.
page_texts.4:
[standards/infrastructure/integration/README.md#std-infra-int-001-event-broker-integration]

### STD-INFRA-INT-001: Event Broker Integration

Standards for integrating enterprise event brokers including broker selection, cluster configuration, network connectivity, and operational management.
page_texts.5:
[standards/infrastructure/integration/README.md#std-infra-int-002-kafka-connect-management]

### STD-INFRA-INT-002: Kafka Connect Management

Standards for deploying and managing Kafka Connect clusters including connector deployment, connector configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
page_texts.6:
[standards/infrastructure/integration/README.md#std-infra-int-002-protocol-translation-gateway]

### STD-INFRA-INT-002: Protocol Translation Gateway

Standards for implementing protocol translation gateways to bridge different messaging protocols and enable cross-platform integration.
page_texts.7:
[standards/infrastructure/integration/README.md#std-infra-int-003-platform-transformation]

### STD-INFRA-INT-003: Platform Transformation

Standards for implementing platform-level data transformation including transformation engine selection, performance optimization, and transformation governance.
page_texts.8:
[standards/infrastructure/integration/README.md#std-infra-int-004-msk-operational-management]

### STD-INFRA-INT-004: MSK Operational Management

Standards for operating Amazon Managed Streaming for Kafka (MSK) including cluster configuration, monitoring, scaling, upgrades, and cost optimization.
page_texts.9:
[standards/infrastructure/integration/README.md#purpose]

## Purpose

These standards ensure:
- Reliable and scalable integration infrastructure
- Consistent integration platform operations
- Proper protocol handling and translation
- Optimized MSK cluster management
- Standard approaches to platform integration
